text:
B011 / T043 completed by codex under the user's instruction to pick up a task and use `plied skill` (0.13.0; generated skill retained in out/plied-SKILL.md). B011 was claimed and released as done; T043's authoritative record remains unchanged for the lead.

Evidence: backlog/B011-e6-bout-end-vs-observed-contact/results/report.md and results/summary.json. Work is isolated to B011, plus the backlog CLI's generated index changes. New files: analyse.ts, run.ts, check.ts, reduce.ts, the report and the stamped summary. All changes are uncommitted. Detailed output is local in the item's out/.

All three planned diagnostic colonies completed on simHash eb48ce968127e6a8, commit f9ad78fb7af8b397eb2bb8a4040f70d429cf98e2, at the provisional default spatial colony, 53 workers, dt 0.1 s. All 630 flow bouts matched distinct uncensored mouth-contact episodes, without missing coverage or direction reversals. Extra contact mean 0.0136508 s; distribution 548 at 0 s, 78 at 0.1 s, 4 at 0.2 s. Physical extension never approached 60 s. Of 12,600 bout/phase pairs and 60 colony/phase comparisons, one gained an observed scan/event; the NF donor and receiver each moved one event-count bin. E6 has integer event-count histograms, not duration histograms. The 60 phases reuse only three colonies and carry no population equivalence claim.

Controls passed for attribution, episode deduplication, strict observer boundaries, no-flow/direction ambiguity, unmatched coverage, identity and event coalescing. A full recorder-free repeat gave identical bouts, forager identities, body/mind state except derived head caches, and conserved totals. Four existing E6 observer tests passed (the seven other tests in that file were skipped); project and strict item TypeScript checks passed, as did independent reduction/source-hash/accounting checks. Total simulation work including the repeat was about 145 s, serial and niced. No run was launched through run.sh. npm run runs showed no active launched jobs and exited 1 due to historical failures.

Current backlog check: one current stamped result, zero stale; dirty-tree annotation reflects the active documentation edits, with simulation inputs clean. Final plied check: 0 errors, 54 warnings (38 review-input, 15 stale, 1 commitment?); no B011/T043 diagnostic. Every diagnostic and reason is retained in out/plied-final-check.json. These authoritative review/record warnings remain outside this agent's role. Baseline comparison was refused after the lead added T060's seal; the refusal is retained in out/plied-baseline-comparison.json. Initial check had 55 warnings; no formal policy-comparable delta is claimed.

This bears on the main line's E6 measurement definition. Proposal for step 9: record geometric contact independently of positive flow for identified trophallactic partners, define direction through zero-flow intervals, retain flow bouts for food accounting, and freeze/check that observer before judging the eventual candidate. This is proposed, not adopted. 84,437 geometric mouth episodes without positive flow have no inferred donor and were explicitly excluded; the result does not establish how such contacts should be scored. It applies only to the tested provisional defaults and does not transfer automatically to the later step-5 candidate or other dt.

Requested lead record work: record the bounded finding and consider closing T043 against B011's quoted outcome while preserving these limitations and the step-9 proposal. No code work or runs remain outstanding for B011. No main-tree model, adopted parameter, frozen artifact or data role was changed; no new paper, held-out or sealed empirical output was inspected. Only the item's permitted pre-existing local specification and source comments/constants were read; no E6 empirical comparison was performed.
